_readme: Singing Pumpkins show settings. Edit on the card, reboot the player. Numbers only; no comments allowed in JSON besides these _ keys.
_dj: DJ mode = when no trick-or-treaters. Shares are target % of PLAYING TIME per face set, not song count.
_atmos_mix: Inside the ATMOS share: relative odds of song / tale / scare.
_run: Play up to this many in a row from one face set before switching (fewer face changes = fewer transitions).
_recent: Never replay a song until at least this many others have played.
_show: SHOW mode = ESP32 sends SHOW. Opening + shuffled Clips 2.0 + close-out, planned to fit show_seconds (Joe 2026-09-27: 2 to 2.5 min after Burt).
_end: What END from the ESP32 does: 'after_clip' = let the current clip finish then close out; 'now' = cut to close-out.
_cooldown: Ignore a new SHOW for this many seconds after a show ends (repeat triggers).
_watchdog: If a clip has not ended this many seconds past its known duration, skip it.
_loop: Calibration: play this jukebox number over and over instead of the DJ loop (166 = test grid, 168 = grid + face ovals). 0 = normal. LOOP 0 from HA/ESP32 ends it until reboot.
